entries.what: Labor Day: no school. Dulce sleeps in, then walks over to Delgado Park with Yesenia for the family picnic crowd and bandstand music.
entries.outcome: Easy day, no shift since Efraín only schedules her Fridays and Sundays.

entries.what: Back at Marisol Gardens she counts her first paycheck money out loud and moves it toward the phone fund.
entries.outcome: Makes a note to keep saving.

entries.what: Walks the 12 minutes down Vinca to Flats High. Gets through geometry and English, then chemistry third period with Ms. Tolentino, sitting by Karina.
entries.outcome: Normal school day; lunch at the B wing planters with the group.

entries.what: Evening at home, texts in the 'las 4' chat and watches edit videos she never posts.
School day with world history, PE volleyball and Spanish for heritage speakers. Eats lunch with Brianna, Karina and Sienna.
entries.outcome: Nothing dramatic; group plans boba for Friday.

entries.what: Does geometry homework at the kitchen table fast, then fumbles the chem lab writeup.
Classes as usual; Eli shares chem notes from behind her. She helps fold to-go boxes? No, saves that for later and goes home after school.
Yesenia reminds her of the 9:30 school-night curfew and the shift tomorrow. Dulce picks out her work shirt.
After school, Dulce takes the 22 bus down Calle Ortega for her 4-9 Friday shift at Taquería Colima, taking orders next to Camila with Héctor's rancheras on the radio.
entries.outcome: Busy shift; gets her free quesadilla plate.

entries.what: Before the shift, she stops at Cloud Nine Tea Bar with Brianna, Karina and Sienna on the way to the football opener crowd. The receipt comes to $31 and she decides to just pay it all so it's not weird.
entries.outcome: She pays the whole $31 herself and hides the annoyance.

entries.what: Efraín closes at 9 and Rafael picks her up in his car; they hear the football opener horns from the stadium.
Saturday laundry at the card-only laundry room in Marisol Gardens.
Drops by the pupusa stand to say hi to Tía Gladys and Rafael, and takes a pupusa.
entries.outcome: Stays an hour and goes home.

entries.what: Evening of scrolling and chatting in the group chat; hears Brianna talk about plans for her birthday.
Takes the 22 bus to Taquería Colima for her Sunday 10-4 shift, working the register through the lunch rush.
entries.outcome: Solid shift; Efraín gives her a free plate.

entries.what: Home after work, she checks her phone fund and starts her Monday chem homework.
Winds down with K-pop playlists and sleeps by 11:30.
